title: Code splitting and loading on demand

videos.script:
Every page of the planner downloads every line of the planner's JavaScript. With three small pages that costs nothing. {{chart}} Then one page gets a chart, from a library, and every page downloads the library, including the pages that never draw a chart.

{{coverage}} You will measure how much of each script a page actually runs, which is the number that says what to split. {{import}} Then two fixes: import only the pieces the chart uses, and load the chart only on the page that needs it, with a dynamic import. Vite does the splitting; you will read what it wrote.

{{when}} Loading on demand has a price: the click waits for the code. You will measure that wait, and remove most of it by starting the download a moment earlier, when the pointer reaches the link.

{{frameworks}} And last, the same idea in the frameworks, where every route is already a file of its own, and one of them needs to be told.
